Website first. Then ongoing assets, led by the podcast.

Foundation

The website comes first. Logo and rebrand, and a story video, are options. Search setup comes with the site.

Growth

Ongoing digital assets led by the podcast: the episode, show notes, social clips, email follow-up, and monthly upkeep. Every piece goes through compliance.

What we can do.

For every MassMutual agency and its advisors. We start with the website, then add content led by the podcast. Logo, rebrand and story video are optional.

  • WebsiteThis is where we start. When someone looks them up, the site tells their story, says who they serve and gives one next step.
  • Logo and rebrandOptional. A logo and a message the practice can use everywhere.
  • Story videoOptional. We film selected advisors telling their story, for the website and later content.
  • PodcastThis leads the ongoing work. They record, and we edit, write the show notes and publish.
  • Social contentShort clips and posts from each episode, every week.
  • GuidesDownloadable guides that answer clients’ real questions.
  • Email follow-upEmails after first meetings and between reviews, so clients keep hearing from them.
  • Search presenceA complete Google profile, pages set up for search and the same details everywhere online.
  • Compliance supportWe check every piece before review, package it for the compliance team and resubmit it after changes.
  • Ongoing maintenanceHosting, security, edits and updates every month.

How it scales.

  1. The GA sponsors.The general agency backs the program for its practices and advisors.
  2. Each agency opts in.It picks its starting pieces from the menu above.
  3. One standard for all.Every agency gets the same standard and the same review package format.

Compliance is part of every step.

Your compliance team makes the calls. We do the prep work.

  1. We pre-check every piece against the rules.
  2. We hand your compliance team a ready-to-approve package.
  3. We submit one small piece at a time.
  4. We work with your firm to keep approvals moving.
